observations: Photo 0 shows an orange LPG gas cylinder with a protective wire mesh around it and a top valve/regulator area visible.
Photo 0 appears to show a small dent/scrape on the cylinder body near the mesh (possible cosmetic damage).
Photo 1 is a close-up of the top/valve area and shows a brass valve fitting; there are handwritten markings on the top (not readable as a brand/model).
No visible brand name, serial number, or stamped cylinder capacity marking is clearly readable in the photos.

identity.kind: LPG gas cylinder (12kg class, foreign cylinder as claimed)

claims.evidence: The photos do not show a clearly readable stamped capacity/serial/standard marking that confirms 12kg or 'foreign' origin.

risks.risk: Capacity/ownership verification: the cylinder may not be the claimed 12kg or may be a different class/size.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped/engraved capacity and serial/ownership markings on the cylinder body (and/or the cylinder neck ring).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic used LPG cylinder with unknown capacity (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Leak/valve condition: valve may be faulty or leaking; photos cannot confirm pressure integrity.
risks.proof: Video of a leak test (soap-bubble test at the valve/regulator connection) and a short pressure/hold test if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed leak-free (worst case: treat as needs inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: Damage affecting safety: dents/impact damage may compromise the cylinder even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of any dents, especially around the shoulder and base, plus a photo of the full cylinder from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used with possible cosmetic/impact damage.

risks.risk: Regulator/hose/accessories not included or not compatible.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included in the sale (regulator, hose, fittings) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as cylinder only (no accessories).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the cylinder’s stamped/engraved capacity (12kg) and serial/standard markings.
Leak test proof: soap-bubble test at the valve and regulator connection (video).
Photos of the entire cylinder body (top, shoulder, sides, base) showing any dents/scratches clearly.
What exactly is included: regulator, hose, and any fittings—show them in one photo.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an LPG cylinder with mesh protection, but they do not clearly verify the claimed 12kg/foreign status or the key safety/value factors (capacity markings and leak/valve condition). Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
